title: Transparência Brasil
description: Website bringing together content, data, and strategies to strengthen public integrity and support journalists, researchers, and public managers.
body:
I was part of the development of a platform dedicated to transparency in Brazil and civic impact — bringing together content, data, and strategies to strengthen public integrity, support journalists, researchers, and public managers, and empower society with accessible and reliable information.

It was truly rewarding to contribute to an initiative that connects evidence, policy, and real-world impact, reinforcing how open and reliable data can elevate public debate and accountability.
